tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Every section sits on this unless it is explicitly a card or a band.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards lifted off the page — project cards, the console panel, the nav bar, cert badges. Never place a surface-raised element directly on a surface-raised parent; use surface-sunken for the band instead.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Full-width section bands that need separating from the page without becoming a card — the Certifications shelf, a pull-quote band. Cards on top of it stay surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. 13.4:1 or better in both modes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken — dates, locations, captions, footer. 5.1:1 or better in both modes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px hairlines and card outlines only — deliberately low-contrast, never the sole indicator of anything. Anything a user must perceive uses border-strong or brand.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning — an input outline, a selected card's edge, a diagram boundary drawn in UI. 3.3:1 or better on surface and surface-raised in both modes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The single identity colour: primary button fill, links, active nav state, focus ring, timeline dots. 5.8:1 or better as text on every surface; 3:1+ as a focus ring.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active state for anything filled or coloured with brand. Darkens in light mode, lightens in dark mode — never apply a CSS filter to brand instead, which clips channels unpredictably.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-hover fill — the primary button label, the avatar monogram, labels inside diagram nodes. 6.4:1 or better on both.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Secondary emphasis that is not actionable — section eyebrows, tech-tag borders and text, the role line under the name. 5.9:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-aws
tokens.usage: The narrow AWS-specialisation signal: certification badges, AWS-managed nodes in diagrams. Deliberately rationed — if more than one section uses it, the page starts implying AWS affiliation rather than AWS expertise.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status text and dot ('Open to new engagements'). Always beside its own word — success and danger are told apart by hue alone here.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status text and dot. Always beside its own word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Negative status text and dot, and the 'problem' callout in a case study. Always beside its own word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral informational status and note callouts. Distinct from brand so an informational note never reads as a call to action.

tokens.name: diagram-canvas
tokens.usage: Background of an architecture diagram. Diagrams are authored once per mode, not recoloured by CSS filter.

tokens.name: diagram-boundary
tokens.usage: Stroke for account, region and VPC boundaries — dashed for logical boundaries, solid for network ones. 5.4:1 or better on diagram-canvas.

tokens.name: diagram-zone-public
tokens.usage: Public subnet / internet-facing zone fill. Zone fills differ by hue, not lightness, so every zone must also carry a text label and its own border style — never fill alone.

tokens.name: diagram-zone-private
tokens.usage: Private subnet / internal zone fill. Same rule: label and border style, never fill alone.

tokens.name: diagram-node
tokens.usage: Primary service node fill in a diagram — the component under discussion. Labels on it use on-brand.

tokens.name: diagram-node-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary service node fill — supporting components. 5.3:1 or better on both zone fills.

tokens.name: diagram-node-aws
tokens.usage: Node fill for an AWS-managed service, to separate what AWS runs from what you built and run.

tokens.name: diagram-flow
tokens.usage: Primary request/data flow arrows. 8.6:1 or better over canvas and both zone fills.

tokens.name: diagram-flow-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary or asynchronous flows, drawn dashed. Distinguished from diagram-flow by dash pattern as well as tone.

tokens.name: diagram-annotation
tokens.usage: Callouts marking the problem, bottleneck or change in a before/after diagram. 5.7:1 or better as text on diagram-canvas.

families.mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'Cascadia Code', monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Your name in the hero. The only place this size appears.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section titles: About, Experience, Certifications, Projects. Also a case study's title.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Company or project name inside a card; a case-study section heading (Problem, Architecture, Outcome).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Role title inside an experience row; a sub-heading inside a case study.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Long-form case-study and article prose only, held to measure-prose width. Never used on the one-page portfolio itself.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Nav links, footer text, captions, secondary sentences.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: A testimonial's words. The attribution line beneath it is body-sm in ink-muted, never italic.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section eyebrows (set in caps by the .section-eyebrow class), tech-tag text, dates and locations, metric labels, diagram labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline service, resource and command names in running text, and code blocks inside a case study.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The number in a metric tile. Mono so a column of figures aligns on the digit.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag vertical padding, the timeline dot's own offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding, gap between tags, status dot to word.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between bullets, gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (with min-height it yields a 44px target), nav link gap, tight card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards in a grid, gap between timeline entries.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section heading to content, the timeline rail's indent, hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on narrow viewports.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on wide viewports.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, form controls, small inline chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards — project tiles, experience rows, diagram figures, testimonials.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The console panel and the avatar frame only. Anything larger reads as a consumer app, not an engineering portfolio.

shadow.note: Two levels only. Elevation is carried mainly by surface colour; shadow is a secondary cue for genuinely floating things.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The sticky nav once the page has scrolled under it. Not used on resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: A card that lifts on hover, and an opened overlay. Never on more than one element in view at rest.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Always paired with a disabled attribute and a not-allowed cursor — opacity alone is not a state.

tokens.name: opacity-muted
tokens.usage: A loading element's resting content while its spinner runs.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Default stacking; diagram layers stay here.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: The sticky nav bar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Skip link on focus, and any dialog if one is ever added.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max width of a section's inner content on the portfolio page.

tokens.name: container-narrow
tokens.usage: Max width for a case-study or article page's furniture.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of long-form body-lg text, holding the line to roughly 70 characters.
